entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 528 aa sequence; predicted molecular mass 56.6 kDa and pI 8.48.
Contains YjeF_N domain (PF03853; residues 27–192) and Carb_kinase domain (PF01256; residues 260–486).
Sequence homologs include reviewed Nnr proteins with 31–34% identity and 74–92% query coverage.
Likely bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme, but exact substrate preference is inferred from homology rather than directly assayed.

entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated with NAD(P)HX epimerase activity (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (EC 4.2.1.136).
The enzyme repairs both NADHX and NADPHX, hydrated/damaged forms of NADH and NADPH.
Reviewed homologs bind one potassium ion per subunit.

entities.name: (6S)-NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: ADP-dependent repair reaction: (6S)-NADHX + ADP → NADH + AMP + phosphate + H+; analogous reaction occurs for (6S)-NADPHX → NADPH.
Mapped to Rhea:32223 and Rhea:32235 in reviewed Nnr homologs.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: Mapped to Rhea:32215 and Rhea:32227 in reviewed Nnr homologs.
